objective: Correct HTTPX request URL construction so explicitly supplied query parameters replace the URL query while omitted parameters preserve it.
acceptance: An explicit empty parameter mapping removes an existing query string.
An explicit non-empty mapping replaces rather than merges with an existing query.
Ordered pairs preserve repeated keys, blank values, order, and URL encoding.
Omitting params preserves the original query and unrelated request behavior remains intact.

source.reproduction: At base, run python -c 'import httpx; print(httpx.Request("GET", "https://example.com/path?old=1", params={}).url)' and observe https://example.com/path?old=1; at the fix commit the same command prints https://example.com/path.
